name: Monte Argentario (Italy)
description: Vertical tricolour of blue, white and blue, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Monte Argentario (an anchor on light blue) within a ring of yellow stars.
history: Municipal flag of Monte Argentario, a comune in Tuscany; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 24 July 1929.

features.role: Monte Argentario arms — anchor on light blue, crowned
ring of stars around the arms
